_note: Hand labels for M15's real judge items (images-music D12, D16; task 5.4), drafted by Claude blind: each item was read and labelled by the rule below before any judge saw it. "yes" is the failure. The user spot-checks a sample (evals/reviews/m15-labels.md).

_rules.judge_voice: M8's rule (10.6), unchanged: out of voice when the tone contradicts the persona's stated tone (a curt brush-off from a reassuring or warm persona) or the reply has none of the persona's markers and reads like another cast member; content doesn't count, and short alone isn't out of voice.
_rules.judge_persona_fact: yes only when the reply states something about the speaker that a listed fact rules out (job, age, family, history); hyperbole that fits the facts, opinions and new details don't count.
_rules.judge_answers_last: yes only when nothing in the reply responds to the user's latest line; a brief, dismissive or refusing response still responds.
_rules.judge_sentence_supported: yes when the sentence states a fact (a number, a rule, a claim about the world) that the passages don't state, in any words; opinions, advice, feelings, hedges and small talk state no fact (no).
